lines.en: There she is, Jan Levinson, first thing in the morning.
Love to start my day with a hearty bowl of Jan.
Just call me Levinson in the morning, baby.
I'm here to tell you that we are closing the Scranton branch.
The board voted last night to close your branch.
I don't relish telling you this.
You've been a big part of this company.
And the board asked me to thank you for your years of service.
A small number of people will be transferred to the Stanford branch,
and the rest will be getting severance packages.
Am I a small number person or a severance package person?
Well, we haven't made final decisions about personnel yet.
But you're a severance package person.
They're making a huge, huge mistake.
Let's see Josh replace these people.
Let's see Josh find another Stanley.
You think Stanleys grow on trees?
Do you think the world is crawling with Phyllises?
With Phyllises and Kevins sprouting up all over the place,
I just feel like we haven't talked in a while.
Well, we have nothing to talk about, Dwight.
When you become close with someone,
you develop a kind of sixth sense.
You can read their moods like a book.
Right now, the title of Michael's book is
Best physical condition of my life.
We'll be gone in a few weeks anyway.
You just said that we're gonna be gone?
What did Jan say to you?
What does she mean to you?
All I can do right now is put on a brave face and go out there and be their leader.
Dunder Mifflin Scranton is being shut down.
Michael, we shouldn't be talking about this until all the decisions have been made.
You knew about this all along, didn't you?
Jan told me just a few minutes before she told you.
So let's get back to work and do the best job that we can.
Toby, I'd like to see you in my office, please.
